note: Tranche E2 Level 2 (out-of-band external monitoring): POST /platform/operations/external-monitor-report, additive over v1.18.0. Severity deliberately absent from the request schema (always server-derived from conditionType). Seven new PLATFORM-domain error codes. This IS the version being implemented by this change set (unlike v1.2.0-v1.18.0, which were vendored as read-only prerequisites) — implementation is limited to Level 2 only; the GitHub Actions workflow and Level 1 direct Telegram fallback described in the same contract remain out of scope for this change set (02_42 §62, mission authorization boundary).
